dialogue_texts: My, what a delightfully gloomy estate.
Sneaking through boundaries in the dead of night always brings out the best flavors of an incident.
My Majesty... I must advise caution.
Fusana has assumed her nighttime princess form, but her soul is entirely choked by the glohm.
I've seen her nighttime appearance before. No need to warn me.
If only I could dance with her to break the spell, but I dare not risk the infection myself.
Please, use your gaps to separate the glohm from her. I shall await a safe conclusion.
Now, follow closely behind my gaps.
We are going to cross the boundary and meet this second troublemaker.
Unless my partner's kiss breaks the seal, I shall drag this entire realm into my endless dream...
Waking up from a dream is simply a matter of shifting a boundary, dear.
If a kiss from your cowardly partner won't do, perhaps the harsh light of reality will suffice?
Insolent creature... You know nothing of the Order's design! Fade into the cold dark!
Oh, I do so dislike uninvited guests trying to redecorate my backyard.
Let us see if your little nighttime performance can handle the weight of Gensokyo's true boundaries!
